dct_description_sm: Points of interest from OSM. Includes public-facing amenities, shops, tourist attractions, and landmarks tagged via `amenity`, `shop`, `tourism`, or `man_made`. Useful for general POI reference, urban analysis, and basemap detail. OpenStreetMap is a free, collaborative world map built by volunteers. Completeness varies by region: urban areas are usually well-mapped, remote areas may be incomplete. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org) - OSM tags: [Key:amenity](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:amenity), [Key:shop](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:shop), [Key:tourism](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:tourism), [Key:man_made](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:man_made) - Part of many [exports grid on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot) by the [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/en/)
